### Anti Dilution
- **[Carve-out: conversion of preferred stock (recursive trigger)](https://nvca.org/wp-content/uploads/2019/06/NVCA-Model-Document-Certificate-of-Incorporation.docx)** (`anti_dilution.carve_out_preferred_self_conversion`)
  - NVCA §4.4.5(a) Excluded Issuances. Conversion of preferred stock itself does not trigger anti-dilution adjustment on other preferred series (no recursive trigger). This carve-out is always applied (consideration = new_money only); A future extension may allow per-series override.
- **[Carve-out: outstanding warrants, options, convertibles](https://nvca.org/wp-content/uploads/2019/06/NVCA-Model-Document-Certificate-of-Incorporation.docx)** (`anti_dilution.carve_out_outstanding_convertibles`)
  - NVCA §4.4.5(b) Excluded Issuances. Shares issued upon conversion or exercise of OUTSTANDING (pre-existing) warrants, options, or convertible securities do not trigger AD — those instruments had contractual conversion rights predating the new round.
- **[Carve-out: Board-approved equity plan grants](https://nvca.org/wp-content/uploads/2019/06/NVCA-Model-Document-Certificate-of-Incorporation.docx)** (`anti_dilution.carve_out_pool_grants`)
  - NVCA §4.4.5(c) Excluded Issuances. Shares issued under a Board-approved equity incentive plan (option grants, RSU grants, the pool refresh itself) do not trigger AD.
- **[Carve-out: stock split / dividend / recapitalization](https://nvca.org/wp-content/uploads/2019/06/NVCA-Model-Document-Certificate-of-Incorporation.docx)** (`anti_dilution.carve_out_recapitalization`)
  - NVCA §4.4.5(d) Excluded Issuances. Stock splits, stock dividends, and recapitalizations are mechanical adjustments that do not trigger AD.
- **[Carve-out: M&A consideration](https://nvca.org/wp-content/uploads/2019/06/NVCA-Model-Document-Certificate-of-Incorporation.docx)** (`anti_dilution.carve_out_ma_consideration`)
  - NVCA §4.4.5(e) Excluded Issuances. Shares issued as merger / acquisition consideration are not dilutive issuances for AD purposes.
- **[Carve-out: equipment lessors / lenders / strategic partners](https://nvca.org/wp-content/uploads/2019/06/NVCA-Model-Document-Certificate-of-Incorporation.docx)** (`anti_dilution.carve_out_lessor_lender_strategic`)
  - NVCA §4.4.5(f) Excluded Issuances. Shares issued to banks, equipment lessors, real-property lessors, or strategic partners in connection with debt, leases, or strategic arrangements are not AD triggers.
- **[Carve-out: acquisitions / JVs](https://nvca.org/wp-content/uploads/2019/06/NVCA-Model-Document-Certificate-of-Incorporation.docx)** (`anti_dilution.carve_out_acquisition_jv`)
  - NVCA §4.4.5(g) Excluded Issuances. Board-approved acquisitions and joint-venture issuances are not AD triggers.
- **[Carve-out: public offering](https://nvca.org/wp-content/uploads/2019/06/NVCA-Model-Document-Certificate-of-Incorporation.docx)** (`anti_dilution.carve_out_public_offering`)
  - NVCA §4.4.5(h) Excluded Issuances. Shares issued in a registered public offering are not AD triggers.
- **[Carve-out: SAFE / convertible note conversion](https://nvca.org/wp-content/uploads/2019/06/NVCA-Model-Document-Certificate-of-Incorporation.docx)** · [Y Combinator](https://www.ycombinator.com/assets/ycdc/Primer%20for%20post-money%20safe%20v1.1-2af8129e12effd9638eeab383b7309142c8f415e5cdb0bc210d573f779177a1c.pdf) (`anti_dilution.carve_out_safe_note_conversion`)
  - NVCA §4.4.5 (by analogy) + YC SAFE primer: shares issued upon conversion of SAFEs or convertible notes are not dilutive issuances for AD purposes — those instruments had contractual conversion rights predating the new round. The new equity round itself triggers AD; the SAFE/note conversion that accompanies it does not double-count.
- **[Carve-out: catch-all reflexive (Board-waived issuances)](https://nvca.org/wp-content/uploads/2019/06/NVCA-Model-Document-Certificate-of-Incorporation.docx)** (`anti_dilution.carve_out_reflexive_catch_all`)
  - NVCA §4.4.5 (catch-all reflexive clause). Issuances that the protected preferred holders waive in writing or that the Board approves with affirmative AD-protected-holder consent are not AD triggers.

### Anti Dilution
- **[Carve-out: conversion of preferred stock (recursive trigger)](https://nvca.org/wp-content/uploads/2019/06/NVCA-Model-Document-Certificate-of-Incorporation.docx)** (`anti_dilution.carve_out_preferred_self_conversion`)
  - NVCA §4.4.5(a) Excluded Issuances. Conversion of preferred stock itself does not trigger anti-dilution adjustment on other preferred series (no recursive trigger). This carve-out is always applied (consideration = new_money only); A future extension may allow per-series override.
- **[Carve-out: outstanding warrants, options, convertibles](https://nvca.org/wp-content/uploads/2019/06/NVCA-Model-Document-Certificate-of-Incorporation.docx)** (`anti_dilution.carve_out_outstanding_convertibles`)
  - NVCA §4.4.5(b) Excluded Issuances. Shares issued upon conversion or exercise of OUTSTANDING (pre-existing) warrants, options, or convertible securities do not trigger AD — those instruments had contractual conversion rights predating the new round.
- **[Carve-out: Board-approved equity plan grants](https://nvca.org/wp-content/uploads/2019/06/NVCA-Model-Document-Certificate-of-Incorporation.docx)** (`anti_dilution.carve_out_pool_grants`)
  - NVCA §4.4.5(c) Excluded Issuances. Shares issued under a Board-approved equity incentive plan (option grants, RSU grants, the pool refresh itself) do not trigger AD.
- **[Carve-out: stock split / dividend / recapitalization](https://nvca.org/wp-content/uploads/2019/06/NVCA-Model-Document-Certificate-of-Incorporation.docx)** (`anti_dilution.carve_out_recapitalization`)

  "source_notes": [
    {
      "rule_id": "anti_dilution.carve_out_preferred_self_conversion",
      "domain": "anti_dilution",
      "title": "Carve-out: conversion of preferred stock (recursive trigger)",
      "summary": "NVCA \u00a74.4.5(a) Excluded Issuances. Conversion of preferred stock itself does not trigger anti-dilution adjustment on other preferred series (no recursive trigger). This carve-out is always applied (consideration = new_money only); A future extension may allow per-series override.",
      "source_ids": [
        "NVCA-CERT-OF-INC"
      ]
    },
    {
      "rule_id": "anti_dilution.carve_out_outstanding_convertibles",
      "domain": "anti_dilution",
      "title": "Carve-out: outstanding warrants, options, convertibles",
      "summary": "NVCA \u00a74.4.5(b) Excluded Issuances. Shares issued upon conversion or exercise of OUTSTANDING (pre-existing) warrants, options, or convertible securities do not trigger AD \u2014 those instruments had contractual conversion rights predating the new round.",
      "source_ids": [
        "NVCA-CERT-OF-INC"
      ]
    },
    {
      "rule_id": "anti_dilution.carve_out_pool_grants",
      "domain": "anti_dilution",
      "title": "Carve-out: Board-approved equity plan grants",
      "summary": "NVCA \u00a74.4.5(c) Excluded Issuances. Shares issued under a Board-approved equity incentive plan (option grants, RSU grants, the pool refresh itself) do not trigger AD.",
      "source_ids": [
        "NVCA-CERT-OF-INC"
      ]
    },
    {
      "rule_id": "anti_dilution.carve_out_recapitalization",
      "domain": "anti_dilution",
      "title": "Carve-out: stock split / dividend / recapitalization",
      "summary": "NVCA \u00a74.4.5(d) Excluded Issuances. Stock splits, stock dividends, and recapitalizations are mechanical adjustments that do not trigger AD.",
      "source_ids": [
        "NVCA-CERT-OF-INC"
      ]
    },
    {
      "rule_id": "anti_dilution.carve_out_ma_consideration",
      "domain": "anti_dilution",
      "title": "Carve-out: M&A consideration",
      "summary": "NVCA \u00a74.4.5(e) Excluded Issuances. Shares issued as merger / acquisition consideration are not dilutive issuances for AD purposes.",
      "source_ids": [
        "NVCA-CERT-OF-INC"
      ]
    },
    {
      "rule_id": "anti_dilution.carve_out_lessor_lender_strategic",
      "domain": "anti_dilution",
      "title": "Carve-out: equipment lessors / lenders / strategic partners",
      "summary": "NVCA \u00a74.4.5(f) Excluded Issuances. Shares issued to banks, equipment lessors, real-property lessors, or strategic partners in connection with debt, leases, or strategic arrangements are not AD triggers.",
      "source_ids": [
        "NVCA-CERT-OF-INC"
      ]
    },
    {
      "rule_id": "anti_dilution.carve_out_acquisition_jv",
      "domain": "anti_dilution",
      "title": "Carve-out: acquisitions / JVs",
      "summary": "NVCA \u00a74.4.5(g) Excluded Issuances. Board-approved acquisitions and joint-venture issuances are not AD triggers.",
      "source_ids": [
        "NVCA-CERT-OF-INC"
      ]
    },
    {
      "rule_id": "anti_dilution.carve_out_public_offering",
      "domain": "anti_dilution",
      "title": "Carve-out: public offering",
      "summary": "NVCA \u00a74.4.5(h) Excluded Issuances. Shares issued in a registered public offering are not AD triggers.",
      "source_ids": [
        "NVCA-CERT-OF-INC"
      ]
    },
    {
      "rule_id": "anti_dilution.carve_out_safe_note_conversion",
      "domain": "anti_dilution",
      "title": "Carve-out: SAFE / convertible note conversion",
      "summary": "NVCA \u00a74.4.5 (by analogy) + YC SAFE primer: shares issued upon conversion of SAFEs or convertible notes are not dilutive issuances for AD purposes \u2014 those instruments had contractual conversion rights predating the new round. The new equity round itself triggers AD; the SAFE/note conversion that accompanies it does not double-count.",
      "source_ids": [
        "NVCA-CERT-OF-INC",
        "YC-PMSAFE-PRIMER"
      ]
    },
    {
      "rule_id": "anti_dilution.carve_out_reflexive_catch_all",
      "domain": "anti_dilution",
      "title": "Carve-out: catch-all reflexive (Board-waived issuances)",
      "summary": "NVCA \u00a74.4.5 (catch-all reflexive clause). Issuances that the protected preferred holders waive in writing or that the Board approves with affirmative AD-protected-holder consent are not AD triggers.",
      "source_ids": [
        "NVCA-CERT-OF-INC"
      ]
    }
